What is MyBodyFuel?

MyBodyFuel is a brand in vitamins and supplements, protein powders, creatine and amino acids. The THH Europe catalogue currently lists 11 products from MyBodyFuel, including MyBodyFuel Calcium, Zink & Magnesium - 60 Tabletten, MyBodyFuel Protein Oats 1050 g and MyBodyFuel Creatine Monohydraat. Together they come in 13 flavours and variants.
